notes.title: Demo Patch #4
notes.notes:
Changelog:

 AI rebalancing pass: Attack chance has been reduced and their reaction time increased.

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- AI activity is now tied to the game speed (makes the game more challenging and dynamic on higher speeds)

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Improved AI balancing (increased the difficulty of the Warmonger AI)
- Fixed Fog of War not being enabled on quicksave load

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Introduced a new Star Quality setting to improve game performance on low-end devices.
- Fixed 1 game crash.
- Small optimisation improvements.

notes.title: Patch: Game Speed control
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118883/31288867b7644aaba1e2d4b819816861d110d1cc.png

Implemented a global speed control widget. You can also pause the game if you want to go on a break.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Fixed fullscreen behavior on alt+tab.
 Music volume starts at 50% by default now.
